facts.business: James Warren Tea Limited is engaged in the cultivation, manufacture, and sale of CTC and Orthodox teas from its four tea estates located in the South Bank of Upper Assam, India.

auditor.name: M/s. B. Chhawchharia & Co., Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Erratic rainfall patterns and fluctuating ambient temperatures affecting crop yields
Growth and proliferation of pests increasing crop protection costs
Labour availability challenges during peak seasons affecting timely plucking
Selling prices failing to keep pace with rising input costs (salaries, wages, gas, electricity, fuel, pesticides, fertilizers)
Adverse effects of climate change and global warming on tea yields and quality
